note: The frozen p5_metrics measures closed gaps only (a reception after the gap); a run aborted inside a gap keeps its correct flight outcome (FAILURE, runner safety abort) but no capture or tilt numbers for that gap. This tool, written after the batches, measures the trailing open gap from raw run evidence (last setpoint arrival before the abort, the in-flight capture, tilt and altitude up to the abort or log end) and writes <batch>/open-gap-supplement.json. It never modifies run directories or their stored metrics.
